Landed on `main` as `0bffdaeae` via PR #7048 (merge queue, 2026-08-09 ~15:4xZ). This card auto-closed on the `Fixes` line; clearing the stale `pm:queue` it was still carrying, keeping `target:v17`.

Artifact verified in `origin/main` rather than read off the PR page: `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (+751/−124) and `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`. The guard now judges `merge-base(base, head)` instead of the whole `.changeset` stock, so an unrelated PR no longer goes red for the 171 files sitting in the release train.

⚠️ **Worth recording as the landing pitfall, because the fix was ready three hours before it merged.** This PR sat `mergeable_state: clean`, every gate green, auto-merge armed since 12:02:43Z — and was in **neither the merge queue nor `origin/main`**. The cause was a stale base, and the remedy was refreshing it; the trap is that "not on `main`" read on its own is ambiguous between *queued and waiting* and *never entered the queue*, and those two have opposite remedies. Reading the queue refs (`gh-readonly-queue/*`) alongside `main` is what disambiguated it — the same shape as #4852. Re-arming an already-armed auto-merge would have looked like progress and changed nothing.

Downstream: #7006 was held out of dispatch pending this landing and has now been released. Its residual is dissolved rather than fixed here — the enforcing path no longer reads `.changeset` at all, so the `no-changeset-dir`→exit-0 path is gone, replaced by `unreadable-diff`→exit 1. Verified against `main` and recorded there; the close/re-grade call stays with triage.
